recipes.name: Homestyle Potato Tomato Curry (Aloo Tamatar)
recipes.description: A comforting, aromatic everyday curry made with diced potatoes, ripe tomatoes, onions, and warm pantry spices.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Ingredient list audited against major 9 allergens; cross-contamination in home kitchens applies.

instructions: Peel and cut the potatoes into 2 cm cubes. Finely chop the onion and dice the tomatoes.
Heat cooking oil in a heavy pan over medium heat. Add cumin and let it sizzle for 15 seconds.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and translucent.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, turmeric powder, chilli powder, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until the tomatoes break down into a thick base.
Add the cubed potatoes and 250 ml of water. Mix well, cover with a lid, and simmer on medium-low heat for 12 to 15 minutes until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Mash two or three potato cubes lightly with the back of the spoon to thicken the curry sauce. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves if available and serve warm.

recipes.name: Cheesy Potato, Onion & Tomato Skillet
recipes.description: Crispy pan-seared potato cubes tossed with caramelized onions, juicy tomatoes, and melted cheese in a single skillet.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0
instructions: Wash and dice the potatoes into small 1.5 cm cubes so they cook quickly. Slice the onion thinly and dice the tomato.
Heat cooking oil in a wide non-stick or cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced potatoes in a single layer with a pinch of salt. Cook undisturbed for 5 minutes until golden underneath, then toss and cook for another 6 to 7 minutes until tender.
Push the potatoes to one side of the pan and add the sliced onion. Sauté for 4 minutes until golden, then mix everything together.
Stir in the diced tomato and black pepper. Cook for 2 minutes until warmed through.
Sprinkle grated cheese evenly over the top, cover the skillet for 1 to 2 minutes until the cheese melts, and serve immediately.

recipes.name: One-Pan Spiced Tomato & Onion Rice
recipes.description: A fragrant, zero-waste dish that transforms leftover or freshly cooked rice with sautéed onions, ripe tomatoes, and mild spices.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Ingredient list audited against major 9 allergens.

instructions: Finely slice the onion and chop the tomatoes into small pieces.
Heat cooking oil in a wide pan over medium heat. If using cumin, add it first and let it crackle for 10 seconds.
Add the sliced onion and sauté for 4 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Add the chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes soften into a glossy masala.
Add the rice and gently fold it into the tomato-onion base so the grains do not break.
Cook on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until heated through. Serve warm.

ingredients.preparation_note: cooked rice (or 120 g uncooked rice, boiled)

recipes.name: Quick Cheesy Tomato & Potato Rice Skillet
recipes.description: Hearty leftover rice simmered with tender potato cubes, sweet onions, juicy tomatoes, and topped with melted cheese.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0
instructions: Peel and finely cube the potato into 1 cm pieces. Chop the onion and dice the tomatoes.
Heat cooking oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the potato cubes and onion together with a pinch of salt and cook for 8 to 9 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until saucy.
Fold in the rice and 50 ml of water. Season with salt and optional cumin or chilli powder, mixing gently until combined.
Top evenly with grated cheese, cover with a lid for 2 minutes on low heat until melted, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Instant Crispy Rice Flour & Onion Dosas (Neer/Onion Crepes)
recipes.description: Delicate, lacy savoury crepes made with gluten-free rice flour, finely chopped onions, and fresh chillies.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Uses gluten-free rice flour (distinct from wheat flour).

instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the rice flour, salt, and 350 ml of water to form a thin, lump-free pouring batter.
Stir the finely chopped onion, finely chopped fresh chilli, and optional cumin seeds into the batter.
Heat a flat cast-iron or non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and brush lightly with cooking oil.
Stir the batter well (as rice flour settles quickly) and pour a ladleful from the outer edge inward in a circular motion.
Drizzle a few drops of cooking oil around the edges and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and golden brown. Fold and serve hot.

ingredients.preparation_note: finely milled rice flour (do not substitute wheat flour)

recipes.name: Creamy Coconut Milk & Potato Stew (Ishtu)
recipes.description: Mild, velvety Kerala-style potato and onion stew simmered in rich coconut milk with fresh ginger and green chillies.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Contains coconut milk (distinct from dairy milk).

instructions: Peel and cube the potatoes. Thinly slice the onion, slit the fresh chilli lengthwise, and julienne the ginger.
Heat cooking oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Sauté the onion, ginger, and fresh chilli for 3 minutes until fragrant without browning.
Add the cubed potatoes, salt, and 150 ml of water. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Lower the heat and pour in the coconut milk. Stir gently and simmer for 3 minutes without boiling vigorously.
Season with freshly ground black pepper and serve warm with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Quick Garlic Butter & Cheese Pasta
recipes.description: Al dente pasta tossed with golden sautéed garlic, rich dairy butter, cracked black pepper, and grated cheese.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Contains dairy butter and dairy cheese.

instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water for 9 to 10 minutes until al dente. Reserve 60 ml of starchy pasta cooking water before draining.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add the thinly sliced garlic and cook gently for 2 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add the drained pasta and reserved pasta water to the skillet. Toss vigorously for 1 minute to emulsify the sauce.
Remove from heat, fold in the grated cheese and black pepper, and serve warm.

recipes.name: Spiced Chickpea, Spinach & Tomato Stew
recipes.description: Nutrient-dense, high-protein stew combining tender chickpeas, wilted spinach, garlic, onions, and tangy tomatoes.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0
instructions: Finely dice the onion, mince the garlic, and chop the tomatoes.
Warm cooking oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Sauté the onion and garlic with cumin for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until broken down.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and 100 ml of water. Simmer for 6 minutes so the chickpeas absorb the flavours.
Fold in the washed spinach leaves and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and optional lemon juice before serving.

recipes.name: Street-Style Onion & Tomato Masala Omelette
recipes.description: Fluffy pan-fried eggs loaded with finely diced onions, tomatoes, turmeric, and optional green chillies.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk briskly with salt and optional turmeric powder until frothy.
Fold in the finely diced onion, seeded and diced tomato, and optional fresh chilli and coriander leaves.
Heat cooking oil in a small non-stick frying pan over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture, tilting the pan so it spreads evenly. Cook for 2 minutes until the base is golden and edges are set.
Flip carefully and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until cooked completely through (ensure no raw egg remains for food safety). Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Wok-Tossed Spring Onion & Garlic Fried Rice
recipes.description: Crisp, savoury fried rice highlighting fresh green spring onions, aromatic garlic, and umami soy sauce.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Standard soy sauce frequently contains wheat unless certified gluten-free tamari is used.

instructions: Finely slice the spring onions, separating the crisp white bases from the bright green tops. Mince the garlic.
Heat cooking oil in a wok or wide skillet over high heat. Add the minced garlic and white spring onion bases, stir-frying for 30 seconds.
Add the chilled cooked rice and toss over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until every grain is separate and hot.
Drizzle soy sauce around the perimeter of the wok and season with salt and optional black pepper.
Fold in the green spring onion tops, toss for 15 seconds, and serve immediately.

ingredients.preparation_note: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

recipes.name: Crunchy Roasted Peanut, Tomato & Rice Skillet
recipes.description: South-Indian inspired tangy tomato and onion rice finished with crunchy roasted peanuts and warm spices.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Contains roasted peanuts (legume allergen; distinct from tree nuts).

instructions: Heat cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the peanuts and toast for 2 minutes until golden and crunchy.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the diced tomato, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the cooked rice and toss gently for 2 to 3 minutes until evenly coated and heated through.

recipes.name: Rustic Dairy Milk & Butter Mashed Potato Gratin
recipes.description: Velvety mashed potatoes whipped with warm dairy milk, real butter, sautéed onions, and baked under a golden cheese crust.
recipes.source_reference: Leftover Chef Verified Test Kitchen Catalogue v1.0

allergens.source_reference: Contains cow's milk, dairy butter, and cheese.

instructions: Peel and boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender, then drain thoroughly.
While potatoes boil, melt half the butter in a small pan and sauté the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes until sweet and golden.
Mash the hot potatoes with the remaining butter, warm dairy milk, and salt until smooth.
Fold in the caramelized onion, transfer to a heatproof dish, top with grated cheese, and broil or bake for 5 to 8 minutes until bubbling.
